_description: Retrieval ground truth for fastapi/fastapi 0.99.0 (983f1d3) -> 0.103.0 (415eb14). Each Features/Fixes item in the official release notes (docs/en/docs/release-notes.md at tag 0.103.0) for 0.99.1-0.103.0 is mapped to its commit. FastAPI squash-merges PRs, so each label is the single commit whose message ends with the PR number from the release notes. The three 0.100.0 milestones all live in one squashed commit (#9816, 274 files changed). Docs, translations, sponsors and dependency bumps are not milestones.

milestones.query: Add support for openapi_examples in all FastAPI parameters
Disable separation of input and output JSON Schemas with separate_input_output_schemas=False
ResponseValidationError printable details in server error logs
Pydantic serialization mode for responses and computed_field support
Replace MultiHostUrl with AnyUrl for compatibility with Pydantic v1
Add support for Pydantic v2 while keeping Pydantic v1 support
New Pydantic Field parameters for Query, Path, Body; regex deprecated in favour of pattern
Settings moved to pydantic-settings package, fastapi[all] includes pydantic-settings and pydantic-extra-types
Fix JSON Schema accepting bools as valid JSON Schemas, additionalProperties false
